content.short: Fina.Cash provides a Visa debit card that can be topped up directly from your crypto wallet.
content.description: Fina.Cash provides a Visa debit card that can be funded directly from your crypto wallet. It uses a DeFi off-ramp that transfers funds straight from the user’s DeFi wallet to the debit card without needing a third-party custodian. You can top up by converting native crypto to EUR at the spot price. The service emphasizes high availability and rapid top-ups, typically completed in about a minute so the card is ready to spend. A proprietary DeFi wallet supports a broad range of IBC networks.
